_help: Missions are short scenes. {me} is whoever is playing; {a1} and {a2} are two other crew members; kiko, dash, pip, sunny are friends from other crews. Each node: lines (who + text), heat (added when the node plays, 0-100 meter), expr (faces), then either next, choices, or end. Choice kinds change heat: hot +20, words -15, minute -40 (the strongest cool-down), calm -10, repair -35. "tense": true marks a choice point where the heat keeps rising live while the choices wait (optional; defaults to any choice node that adds heat). Lines move on by themselves after 2.5 s + 60 ms per character; the line right before choices always waits. Endings with repair:true score highest (3). There is no fail state.

missions.title: Snap!
missions.blurb: A lace breaks right before your battle round.

lines.text: The Park Jam battle starts in two minutes!
{me}, you're up first. Ready?
{me} pulls the laces tight… SNAP!
The lace breaks right in half.

choices.text: Kick the sneaker across the floor!
I need a minute.
“Argh! My lace broke and I'm SO frustrated.”

lines.text: THUNK! The sneaker bonks the wall.
Whoa! You okay?
Everyone gets heated sometimes. What now?

choices.text: Rewind! “Sorry, Kiko. That wasn't cool. Can I try again?”
I need a minute.

lines.text: No worries. Laces are the WORST.
Want to fix it together?
{me} sits on the bench and takes three slow breaths.
In… and out. The Heat Meter cools down.

choices.text: “{a1}, my lace snapped. Can you help?”

lines.text: I've got an idea! Let's borrow the string from your hoodie.
It fits perfectly. Good as new!

choices.text: “Thanks, {a1}. Sorry I got so grumpy back there.”
“Battle time! Let's GO!”

lines.text: {me} laces up and dances the best round of the day.
That was SO good!
{me} jumps in and dances a great round.
Nice save!

missions.title: Solo Swap
missions.blurb: Someone else gets the solo you wanted.

lines.text: The crew is picking who dances the solo.
{me} has practised ALL week for this.
And the solo goes to… {a1}!
Me? No way! YES!

choices.text: “That's NOT FAIR!” and stomp out.
I need a minute.
“I'm really disappointed. I wanted that solo.”

lines.text: SLAM goes the door. The studio goes quiet.
Everyone gets heated sometimes. It's what happens next that counts.

choices.text: Rewind! Walk back in: “Sorry for slamming. Can I try that again?”
I need a minute.

lines.text: Thanks for coming back. That took guts.
{me} gets a drink of water and counts to ten.
The disappointed feeling is still there — but smaller.

choices.text: “I'm disappointed. I really wanted that solo.”

lines.text: That makes sense. You worked hard.
How about you lead the big group move instead?

choices.text: “Deal. And {a1} — congrats. You'll be awesome.”
“Okay. I'll lead the group move.”

lines.text: Thanks! Will you help me practise my solo?
Two dancers. Two big moments. One happy crew.
{me} leads the group move — and it looks great.

missions.title: Cap Trouble
missions.blurb: Your cap won't go on — and someone keeps trying to help.

lines.text: Five minutes to showtime. {me} grabs the crew cap.
It won't go on. It's squashing everything!
Here, let me do it!
{a1} tugs the cap. It's worse. {a1} tugs again.

choices.text: Shove {a1}'s hands away: “STOP IT!”
I need a minute.
“Can you stop for a sec? I want to try it myself.”

lines.text: Whoa! I was just trying to help.
Everyone gets heated sometimes. The Heat Meter is way up.

choices.text: Rewind! “Sorry I shoved you. Can I try that again?”
I need a minute.

lines.text: Okay. Thanks for saying sorry.
I'd like to try it myself first, please.
{me} puts the cap down and shakes out both hands.
Shake, shake, shake. Breathe.

choices.text: “Can I try it myself first? Then you can help.”

lines.text: Psst! Loosen the strap at the back first.
Click. The strap loosens. The cap slides on perfectly.

choices.text: “Thanks, Pip! And sorry, {a1} — I know you were helping.”
“Got it! Showtime!”

lines.text: Next time I'll ask before I help.
Cap on. Crew ready. Lights up!
Cap on. {me} runs to the stage just in time.

missions.title: Speaker Glitch
missions.blurb: The music keeps cutting out just when you're nailing it.

lines.text: {me} is dancing the best run-through EVER.
Then — the music cuts out.
Sorry! Fixing it… okay, go!
Three steps in… it cuts out AGAIN.

choices.text: Yell: “You RUINED it!”
I need a minute.
“This is so annoying! I was doing so well.”

lines.text: Hey… I'm trying my best.
Everyone gets heated sometimes. {me} can still turn this around.

choices.text: Rewind! “Sorry for yelling. It's not your fault.”
I need a minute.

lines.text: Thanks. It IS really annoying, huh?
{me} walks a slow lap around the studio.
Step… step… step. Cooler already.

choices.text: “That was so annoying! I was doing really well.”

lines.text: Hey! No music? Dance to a clap beat!
Clap… clap… clap-clap-clap! It actually works!

choices.text: “{a2}, thanks for fixing it. Want to clap the beat with me?”
“Clap beat! Let's go!”

lines.text: {a2} claps. Dash claps. {me} dances the whole routine.
Best glitch EVER.
{me} finishes the routine to Dash's clap beat.

missions.title: Bumped!
missions.blurb: Someone crashes into your big move.

lines.text: The studio is PACKED today.
{me} goes for the big spin…
BONK! Pip backs right into {me}.
{me} wobbles and lands flat on the floor.

choices.text: Push Pip: “WATCH IT!”
I need a minute.
“Ow! You bumped me and it messed up my spin.”

lines.text: I… I didn't see you. Sorry.
Pip looks like they might cry. Everyone gets heated sometimes.

choices.text: Rewind! “Sorry I pushed you, Pip. I was just surprised.”
I need a minute.

lines.text: It's okay. It was an accident.
{me} stays on the floor for a second. Big breath.
It was an accident. Pip didn't mean it.

choices.text: “Ow! You bumped me and it messed up my spin.”

lines.text: I'm really sorry! I was trying a backwards step.
Maybe we need spin lanes. Left side for spins, right side for steps?

choices.text: “Good idea. Pip, want to share the spin lane with me?”
“Okay. I'll spin on the left.”

lines.text: Really? Yes!
{me} and Pip take turns spinning. Nobody gets bonked.
Spin lane on the left. {me} lands it this time!

missions.title: Battle Round
missions.blurb: The Neon Owls win the practice battle.

lines.text: Practice battle! {me} versus Kiko!
Both dancers give it everything.
And the winner is… KIKO!
Woo! Good battle!

choices.text: “Kiko cheated! That's so unfair!”
I need a minute.
“I really wanted to win. I'm bummed.”

lines.text: I didn't cheat…
Losing feels hot and prickly. Everyone gets heated sometimes.

choices.text: Rewind! “Sorry, Kiko. You didn't cheat. You were really good.”
I need a minute.

lines.text: Thanks. You were really good too!
{me} squeezes both fists tight… then lets go.
Squeeze… and let go. The prickly feeling fades.

choices.text: “I really wanted to win. I'm bummed.”

lines.text: Losing a round is how dancers learn. What was your best move?
Your kick-step was SO sharp. Teach me?

choices.text: “Deal! Good battle, Kiko.” — and a high five.
“Maybe next time.”

lines.text: SMACK! The loudest high five in the park.
THAT is crew spirit.
{me} takes a breather, then practises the kick-step some more.

missions.title: My Turn!
missions.blurb: Someone keeps picking the song — and it's never your turn.

lines.text: Crew practice at home. Everyone takes turns picking the song.
My pick! This one's a banger.
Next song… {a2} picks AGAIN. And again.
Ooh, one more!

choices.text: Grab the speaker: “MY TURN!”
I need a minute.
“Hey, I've been waiting. Can I pick the next one?”

lines.text: Hey! Careful with that!
Everyone gets heated sometimes. Waiting is hard.

choices.text: Rewind! Hand it back: “Sorry for grabbing. Can I have the next turn?”
I need a minute.

lines.text: Oh! Sorry — I got carried away. Next one's yours.
{me} flops on the sofa and does five bunny breaths.
Sniff-sniff-sniff… whoosh. Better.

choices.text: “I've been waiting a long time. Can I pick next?”

lines.text: Let's make a turn list so it's fair!
Good idea. {me} goes first.

choices.text: “Thanks! Your song was good too, {a2}. Want to dance to mine?”
Pick the song and press play!

lines.text: {me} picks a song. Everybody dances. The turn list goes on the fridge.
{me}'s song fills the room. Finally!

missions.title: One More Time
missions.blurb: A new move just won't click.

lines.text: {me} is learning a brand-new move.
Try one: wobble. Try two: feet all tangled.
Try three: {me} trips over their own sneakers.
One more time!

choices.text: “I'm TERRIBLE at this! I quit!”
I need a minute.
“This is really hard. I'm getting frustrated.”

lines.text: Hey, you're not terrible. You're LEARNING.
Everyone gets heated sometimes. Even pro dancers.

choices.text: Rewind! “Sorry I snapped. Can we try it slower?”
I need a minute.

lines.text: Slower is smart. Let's do it together.
{me} takes a water break and stretches up tall.
Reach… and flop. Reach… and flop.

choices.text: “This is really hard and I'm frustrated.”

lines.text: It took me TWENTY tries. Break it into little bits.
Step. Pop. Turn. Bit by bit… it clicks!

choices.text: “Thanks for sticking with me, {a1}. Sorry I got grumpy.”
“I DID IT!”

lines.text: Anytime. Now teach ME!
Try twenty-one: perfect.
{me} lands the move. Tricky moves just need more tries.
